scope: IID continuous Gaussian observational discovery and singleton total-effect multisets. FCI/PAG, interventional GIES, sequential histories and non-Gaussian methods require separately reviewed paths.

request.variables: Ordered unique IDs; each has label, role, measured_at, available_at, unit and transform. IDs are case-sensitive and preserved across column permutation.
request.sampling_design: Initial path requires iid units and declared Gaussian CI/linear SEM scope. Repeated customer rows, cluster sampling, longitudinal/selected samples and survey weights are unsupported unless another reviewed route is chosen.

pc_gaussian.input: Either complete finite numeric n-by-p observations, or a named p-by-p correlation matrix plus integer n and provenance. Summary input cannot establish that iid/Gaussian assumptions hold.
validation: At least two variables and initially at most twelve; caps are proposal choices, not measured package limits.
No missing/nonfinite values, constant columns or unnamed/repeated columns.
Symmetry/diagonal/positive definiteness checked with recorded numerical tolerances.
n-p-1>0 for the largest possible Fisher-Z conditioning set; small-sample usefulness is still a separate issue.
Raw observations are centered/scaled only with recorded invertible transformations.
alpha must be supplied in (0,1); it is a per-test level, not a graph-level false discovery rate.
Record condition-number/rank tolerances and check each used conditioning matrix. No claimed numerical equivalence from package documentation alone.

configuration.indepTest: strict_gaussian_ci (project callback proposed; not yet implemented or engine-verified)
configuration.m.max: p-2 (full search within the initial p cap)

pc_gaussian.configuration_note: Conservative relaxed PC with conflict-preserving orientation. Do not infer a CPDAG from the object class; conflicts and incomplete orientation require refusal of IDA. Stable.fast and its compiled CI route are excluded from this initial callback path.
pc_gaussian.ci_wrapper: Compute conditional correlation and Fisher-Z from checked SPD submatrices with Cholesky solves. Reject rank loss, nonpositive residual variances, invalid df, nonfinite arithmetic, |r|>=1, or ill conditioning beyond a prospectively frozen tolerance. No pseudoinverse, NA-to-zero fallback, clipping, or silent regularization. Catch warnings and record diagnostics; require numeric scalar p in[0,1]. Compare to gaussCItest on well-conditioned fixtures before admission; deliberate failure behavior differs. This is a new project callback, not a claim that unmodified gaussCItest has these checks.
pc_gaussian.constraints: Initial route excludes required/forbidden edges and background constraints. A separate provenance-bearing PDAG design must specify their compatibility, orientation closure and effect semantics before enabling them.

ida_singleton.input: One treatment ID, one distinct outcome ID, original-scale covariance and a validated CPDAG; matching node coordinates, population and sampling law required.
ida_singleton.meaning: Total derivative in the declared linear Gaussian causal SEM, per treatment unit, over compatible DAGs; not a generic ATE for arbitrary interventions.
ida_singleton.method: Initial local singleton method, y.notparent=false, type=cpdag; global enumeration is a separately capped oracle. Optimal/multivariate/PDAG routes remain excluded until their separate finite-sample contracts are reviewed.
ida_singleton.admission: Inspect unmodified weighted graph matrix before any nonzero coercion. Require exact allowed codes, zero diagonal, named node alignment, matching covariance order and no2/2 conflict. Apply strict CPDAG and consistent-extension checks that abort on false/error, before calling ida. ida message() is not a refusal. Never repair by orienting unresolved edges or applying y.notparent=true.
exclusions: Multivariate/joint interventions on this initial path
Nonlinear binary outcomes without a reviewed model
Single confidence interval requested from a bare IDA multiset

representation.internal_graph: Named node list and edges carrying an endpoint at each named node: tail/arrow/circle. Include graph_class and algorithmic_conflict separately.
representation.pc_graph: For as(pcAlgo,"matrix"), type=amat.cpdag, i->j is A[i,j]=0,A[j,i]=1. For as(pcAlgo@graph,"matrix"), the inspected implementation uses row-as-source graph adjacency, i->j=(1,0). wgtMatrix defaults to transpose=TRUE. Verify installed graph coercion on named fixtures and preserve pre-coercion weights; do not treat all nonzero entries as1. Reciprocal1/1 is undirected; reciprocal2/2 is a PC algorithmic conflict and requires refusal. Retain exact accessor and package revisions.
representation.ancestral_matrix: For pcalg amat of the documented ancestral-graph type, A[i,j] is the endpoint at j: 0 absent, 1 circle, 2 arrow, 3 tail. Thus i->j is A[i,j]=2, A[j,i]=3. This mapping is recorded for refusal/roundtrip diagnostics; the initial PC/IDA path does not accept PAGs.
representation.conflicts: A bidirected orientation conflict from a PC option is an algorithmic conflict, not evidence of a latent common cause. If the engine serializer cannot distinguish the relevant states, return unsupported_encoding.
representation.validation: Retain original engine representation and conversion digest; validate endpoints, symmetry of adjacency existence, graph type and consistent extension before an effect calculation. Validation must not silently orient unresolved edges. A PC conflict code2/2 and a PAG bidirected code2/2 have different scientific meanings; encode the origin, not just numbers.
representation.effect_multiset: Numeric entries with multiplicity and compatible parent-set/DAG witness where available; distinct-value set is a separately labeled summary. No averaging or interval hull replaces the original object.
representation.uncertainty: graph_equivalence_ambiguity is distinct from sampling uncertainty. covariance-derived point multisets have sampling_uncertainty=not_computed. Posterior credible intervals, confidence sets and bootstrap stability have different labels.

units_and_clock.formula: If X_new=c_X X and Y_new=c_Y Y, theta_new=(c_Y/c_X)theta for each effect. Covariance transforms as S_new=D S D^T; correlations alone cannot restore original effect units.
units_and_clock.example: For X in percentage points and Y in thousands of currency, .48 becomes 4.8 currency/basis point. A 25bp contrast is 120 currency per unit only in the forward-chain model; equivalent graphs also permit zero.
units_and_clock.restriction: A time label does not make iid rows valid; one row per independently sampled unit is a scientific design condition. Exclude outcomes/mediators recorded after the decision from baseline feature claims.
units_and_clock.nonlinear_transform: Reject an unreviewed nonlinear unit transformation for derivative reporting; local derivative and finite contrast are different targets.

rules: No graph selection to create a preferred economic answer.
An empty numerical vector from an error is not a zero effect or empty identified set.
No confidence level attached to an uncalibrated multiset.
Resource cutoff returns an incomplete/refused result with last stage and diagnostics; no silent m.max reduction.
All CLI/MCP clients receive the same structured result variants; display layers cannot drop unresolved endpoints.

deployment.proposed_transport: Versioned JSON over an isolated local Rscript process; no arbitrary R code in a request. Large local matrices use content-addressed local files with schema/order/hash checks.
requirements: Pin R version, pcalg source archive/commit and runtime dependencies, including compiled libraries.
Record Rcpp/RcppArmadillo/BH and graph/RBGL/igraph versions and build system.
GPL >=2 source/dependency obligations reviewed before packaging; process isolation is not a license exemption.
Capture stdout/stderr separately from JSON results.
Initial single process/core; timeout and memory budget supplied explicitly.
deployment.scope_boundary: All future adapter code/tests stay in causal; no sibling repository execution or edits are authorized by this contract.
deployment.custody: No external uploads; local artifact identity does not establish scientific truth or human ownership.

behavioral_oracles.expected: X->M->Y survives export/import and a node permutation; a deliberate transpose must fail the expected-direction comparison.

Exact Gaussian law with covariance [[1,.6,.48],[.6,1.36,1.088],[.48,1.088,1.8704]] and oracle X independent Y given M has undirected path X-M-Y; compatible effects contain 0 and .48. No finite-sample PC exact-recovery claim.
X->M<-Y is different from an undirected chain; v-structure preserved in named endpoint roundtrip.
Endpoint decoder roundtrip preserves codes; initial PC/IDA numerical route returns unsupported_graph_class.
IDA values transform by c_Y/c_X; .48 thousand/pp corresponds to 4.8 currency/bp; retain zeros/multiplicities.
diagnostic_failure or invalid_request; no successful discovery from NA deletion.
Preserve diagnostic; effect calculation unavailable; no arbitrary consistent extension.
unsupported_sampling_design with a route to a separate dependence-aware contract.
resource_exhausted or unsupported_engine_revision with all-request denominator retained.
Singular and invalid-df fixtures fail before numerical inference; returned finite p alone is insufficient. No regularized substitute.
Named collider survives each accessor and all six node permutations. A transpose reverses directions and fails. Detect2/2 before ida normalizes nonzero weights.
A non-CPDAG aborts before ida even if native function would merely emit a message.
Three-DAG path gives global[0,0,.48], local[0,.48] in the exact model. Do not turn a2/3 zero frequency into a posterior probability.

executed_evidence.anchor: Project references only; no R adapter

design_review.remaining_implementation_work: Local implementation is eligible under the pinned reuse decision. Pin and install a compatible R/dependency build; implement strict CI/conversion/admission; execute the full named, permutation, graph, numerical, unit and failure fixtures before claiming engine_executed or runtime qualification. Performance studies remain prospective.
